description: This file provides utilities for parsing and comparing Linux kernel versions, including functions to retrieve the current kernel version and compare it against a specified version.

classes.name: KernelVersion
classes.description: A slice of uint64 representing the numerical components of a Linux kernel version.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the kernel version as a dot-separated string.

methods.name: parseKernelVersion
methods.description: Parses a version string into a KernelVersion type.

methods.name: getKernelVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the current kernel version of the running Linux system.

methods.name: GreaterEqualThan
methods.description: Checks if the current kernel version is greater than or equal to a specified version.
